name: 71457 · Natchitoches, LA
findings: ZIP 71457 (Natchitoches) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71457 (Natchitoches) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 71457 (Natchitoches) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
